name: Admin — system settings expose the SLA budgets and the CENRO office coordinates

planSteps.description: A list of settings is shown, each with its key, its current value and a Save control
The settings include complaint_sla_minutes with a whole-number value
The settings include cenro_office_lat and cenro_office_lng, both holding decimal coordinates
The cenro_office_lat value begins "14." and cenro_office_lng begins "121.", placing the office in Cabuyao
